setup.zh: 筑基第二天夜里，观主摊开舆图，指头按在北边一条弯弯的墨线上：邺城年年给河伯娶妇。二十来天后，你、周衡，还有石阶底下蹲着的阿禾，北上到了漳水边。
setup.en: The night after your Foundation, the abbot unrolls a map and presses a finger on a winding ink line in the north: every year the city of Ye gives the River Lord a bride. Some twenty days later you, Zhou Heng, and Ahe — found squatting at the foot of the steps — reach the Zhang.

recap.zh: 北上到了漳水，对岸是邺城；周衡望着河心那片最深的水，一个字也没记。
recap.en: North to the Zhang, Ye on the far bank; Zhou Heng stared at the deepest water mid-river and wrote down not a word.

zh: 黄里带青，一眼望不到底。
周衡的账簿合着，一个字也没记。
en: The tenth evening, at the Zhang.
Yellow shot with green, no seeing the bottom.
Zhou Heng's ledger stays shut; not one word.

story.zh:
动身前一夜，瞿老把他叫进草屋，只教了十六个字：「[内观之道，静神定心。乱想不起，邪妄不侵]{典=neiguan-jing}。」又添了一句：「筑了基，往里头看。」

第十天，十月初七傍晚，三人到了漳水边上。小满侧着耳朵，听了一会儿。那水声底下，也压着一个极慢、极沉的声音，跟泗水底下那一个一样，睡得更沉。

一回头，却见周衡站在岸上，不动了。小满道：「周师兄？」周衡道：「沈师叔，我听见了。」这一回，他竟没说「记账」。
story.en:
The night before they set out, Elder Qu had called him into the thatched hut and taught him just sixteen characters: "[The Way of looking within: still the spirit, settle the heart. Stray thoughts do not rise; nothing crooked gets in]{典=neiguan-jing}." He added, "Once you've laid your foundation, look inside."

On the tenth day, the evening of the seventh of the tenth month, the three of them reached the bank of the Zhang. Xiaoman tilted his head and listened for a while. Under the sound of the water lay another sound too, very slow and very deep, the same as the one under the Si, only sleeping more soundly.

When he turned round he saw Zhou Heng standing on the bank, not moving. Xiaoman said, "Senior brother Zhou?" Zhou Heng said, "Martial Uncle Shen, I heard it." This time, of all things, he didn't say "put it on the books."

story_full.zh:
动身前一夜，试完了剑，瞿老把他叫进草屋，只教了十六个字：「[内观之道，静神定心。乱想不起，邪妄不侵]{典=neiguan-jing}。」又添了一句：「筑了基，往里头看。」顿了一顿，「心慌，一口气当半口；心静，一口气当两口。」便赶他下山睡觉去了。

第十天，十月初七傍晚，三人到了漳水边上。

那漳水比泗水宽，也比泗水浑，黄里带青，一眼望不到底，水面上平平的，几乎瞧不出它在流，只偶尔翻起一个漩涡，打个转，又沉了下去。

小满侧着耳朵，听了一会儿。那水声底下，也压着一个极慢、极沉的声音，跟泗水底下那一个一样，睡得更沉。

阿禾「哇」了一声，小狰冲着河面「嗷」了一声，小满也想说句什么，一回头，却见周衡站在岸上，不动了。

小满道：「周师兄？」周衡道：「沈师叔，我听见了。」

这一回，他竟没说「记账」。
story_full.en:
The night before they set out, after the sword test, Elder Qu had called him into the thatched hut and taught him just sixteen characters: "[The Way of looking within: still the spirit, settle the heart. Stray thoughts do not rise; nothing crooked gets in]{典=neiguan-jing}." He added, "Once you've laid your foundation, look inside." He paused. "When your heart's in a panic, one breath does the work of half; when your heart's still, one breath does the work of two." Then he chased him off down the mountain to sleep.

On the tenth day, the evening of the seventh of the tenth month, the three of them reached the bank of the Zhang.

The Zhang was wider than the Si River and muddier too, yellow with green in it, and you couldn't see the bottom; its surface lay so flat you could hardly tell it was flowing, only now and then a whirlpool turned over, spun once, and sank again.

Xiaoman tilted his head and listened for a while. Under the sound of the water lay another sound too, very slow and very deep, the same as the one under the Si, only sleeping more soundly.

Ahe said "Wah," the little zheng let out a howl at the river, and Xiaoman wanted to say something too, but when he turned round he saw Zhou Heng standing on the bank, not moving.

Xiaoman said, "Senior brother Zhou?" Zhou Heng said, "Martial Uncle Shen, I heard it."

This time, of all things, he didn't say "put it on the books."

exits.means: goes to the town, follows the road, looks for an inn

story.zh: 邺城城池不小，街上却没什么人。说没人也不对，人都缩着：家家户户关着门，门缝里透出一双一双眼睛，瞧见他们三个外乡人，又一双一双地缩了回去。
story.en: Ye was no small city, yet there was hardly anyone in the streets. Not that there was no one; everyone was shrinking back. Every door was shut, pair after pair of eyes showed through the cracks, and on seeing three strangers, pair after pair drew back again.

exits.means: tries to enter the river, swim, or reach what lies under it now

text.zh: 水没到膝盖就把你往下拽。周衡一把拉你回来：「天黑了，渡船要加钱。」
text.en: The water is at your knees and already pulling you down. Zhou Heng hauls you back: "It's getting dark — the ferry charges extra."

exits.means: asks about the river, the town, or the River Lord

text.zh: 周衡不答，只望着河心那一片最深、最黑的水。
text.en: Zhou Heng does not answer; he only looks at the deepest, darkest water mid-river.
